name: Lightfall-TS-TW
title: Lightfall
blurb: Streaks of light fall from above with optional mouse interaction.
description: WebGL-rendered falling light streaks with configurable colors, density, and mouse influence. Supports glow, twinkle, and blend modes.
use_when: Atmospheric backgrounds with rain-like light particles.
avoid_when: Low-end devices without WebGL support; continuous rendering.
a11y: Decorative background. No keyboard or focus handling required.
